column1: # Code-range audit (GS14; traps 26, 40, 41): vendor C (vendor/alchemy/games/tbs at the pinned commit) that
# tells code from data by a value's numeric range or high bits, or measures code by address differences.
# In wasm a code address is a function-table index (0x10000-0x1ffff). Rows are produced by the patterns of
# tools/wasm/code_range_audit.py (run by tools/web_build.sh as stage "audit": a hit with no row fails the build).
# verdict: data (the value is never code), safe (the test still works on table indices), fixed (port/c_rules.tsv
# or port/pc changes it), replaced (the vendor code is not compiled), unused. Cites file:line + pattern id only.
